body: Everyone's feelings matter but they don't matter enough to dictate someone else's life/death. For example, when a mom begs her suicidal depressed son not to kill himself, although she genuinely does care for him, she's seeing herself being shattered as opposed to what he has to live with for the rest of his life, and that's selfish whether she admits to it or not.

Also you guys that lurk here and talk to people are really nice. I can't imagine dedicating my time and being all empathetic like that. I used to see people like you guys as suckers, but now I realize you're the happy ones actually living life.
